description: This file defines the UnsafeInMemorySorter class, which implements an in-memory record sorting mechanism using key-prefix sorting, with support for radix sort and custom comparators. It manages memory buffers, sorting logic, and iteration over sorted records within the Apache Spark project.

classes.name: UnsafeInMemorySorter
classes.description: A class for in-memory sorting of records using key-prefix sorting, supporting radix sort and custom comparators within Apache Spark.

classes.name: UnsafeInMemorySorter.SortedIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing sorted records in UnsafeInMemorySorter.

classes.name: UnsafeInMemorySorter.SortComparator
classes.description: Comparator class used for sorting records based on key prefixes and record data.

methods.name: UnsafeInMemorySorter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sorter with memory, comparator, and radix sort support.

methods.name: getUsableCapacity
methods.description: Calculates the usable capacity of the buffer based on radix sort support.

methods.name: getInitialSize
methods.description: Returns the initial size of the pointer array buffer.

methods.name: freeMemory
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the pointer array.

methods.name: numRecords
methods.description: Returns the number of records inserted into the sorter.

methods.name: getSortTimeNanos
methods.description: Returns total sorting time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns the current memory usage of the sorter.

methods.name: hasSpaceForAnotherRecord
methods.description: Checks if there is space for inserting another record.

methods.name: expandPointerArray
methods.description: Expands the internal pointer array to a new LongArray.

methods.name: insertRecord
methods.description: Inserts a record pointer and key prefix into the sorter.

methods.name: getSortedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the sorted records, performing sorting if necessary.
